verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own marketing directly claims built-in delegation to AI: "Delegate any task" to a "Super Agent" that "Works 24/7". It also names in-product agents (Codegen Agent, Triage Agent), lets users build custom agents, and says Brain² has live context on tasks, docs and conversations. The MCP server is for external AI and is not counted here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how delegation to agents works (assignment flow, scope, limits), hands-on or independent corroboration that agents complete delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Brain² sees your tasks, docs, and conversations.
